querySql:
select 
                                      id,
                                      stock_code,
                                      stock_name,
                                      con_date,
                                      con_year,
                                      report_mean_eps_w,
                                      report_mean_eps_m,
                                      report_mean_eps_q,
                                      report_max_eps_w,
                                      report_max_eps_m,
                                      report_max_eps_q,
                                      report_min_eps_w,
                                      report_min_eps_m,
                                      report_min_eps_q,
                                      report_mean_np_w,
                                      report_mean_np_m,
                                      report_mean_np_q,
                                      report_max_np_w,
                                      report_max_np_m,
                                      report_max_np_q,
                                      report_min_np_w,
                                      report_min_np_m,
                                      report_min_np_q,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'zyyx_der_report_extre.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.der_report_extre WHERE con_date BETWEEN '${beg_date}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${beg_date}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
